source.generator: mne_connectivity spectral gc (state-space), per source README; AIC per-subject order selection pipeline as described in README-source.md

method_params.method: granger_bivariate_spectral (mne-connectivity spectral gc, state-space, Barnett & Seth 2015)
method_params.order: AIC-selected per subject (4-25); pooled bivariate VAR full-model OLS-AIC, unified 500-25 truncation
method_params.window: first 500 samples (2 s) per trial, 30 trials pooled
method_params.data: mild depression EEG_ALL.mat [1200,128,1500], 40 subjects (first 20 MDD, last 20 HC), Cz reference

caliber_note: 数据有效带宽 ≈0.5–50 Hz（低通 ≈50 Hz，Cz 参考）；51–125 Hz 频段在数据中已衰减 −24 dB 以下 ⇒ 1–125 Hz 积分值主要由 50 Hz 以下贡献（源 README 原文登记）。与 v1（fixed8-f1-45 档）逐被试矩阵 Pearson 相关 median=0.148 (min=-0.024, max=0.672, n=40)——两参考结构差异大，双对照各自独立登记，不做优劣判断。

subject_mapping.rule: sid = EEG_ALL index + 1 (zip 顺序编号)
subject_mapping.verification: 四锚点 bitwise 复验（本脚本重做）: idx0=m_1(sid1) maxabsdiff=0.0; idx19=m_20(sid20) maxabsdiff=0.0; idx20=h_1(sid21) maxabsdiff=0.0; idx39=h_20(sid40) maxabsdiff=0.0
